verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes self-serve pricing without a sales call: a free plan with 250 searches/month, a Cloud 1M tier at $3,750/mo for 1,000,000 searches, and month-to-month billing you can cancel anytime. A community user independently cites Production at $150 for 15,000 searches/month, and docs state that cached searches are free and don't count toward monthly searches. missing for 10: an explicit per-request or overage rate (cost per search is only implied by plan quotas), the full tier table in the evidence, and enterprise volume pricing, which requires contacting sales.
